title: Briggs & Stratton Australia Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of Victa Lawncare Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commenced.
ACCC requested further information from Briggs & Stratton Australia Pty Ltd. ACCC timeline suspended.
ACCC received further information from Briggs & Stratton Australia Pty Ltd. ACCC timeline recommenced.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Market definition: The proposed acquisition was considered in the markets for: - the supply of engines to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) for the production of mowers intended for Australian consumers (Engines Market); and - the supply of mowers within Australia (Mowers Market)
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets because: -  there were sufficient alternative sources of engines available; and - the merged firm would continue to face strong competition from the vertically integrated mower suppliers which would be unaffected by any foreclosure attempts by the merged firm.
